acceptance: Bulk selection, pagination and rate limits remain correct under hidden/virtualized records and concurrent updates.

positive.fixture: selected_ids, visible_page and all_matching plans re-resolved from a fresh listing; per-item dedup token; Retry-After honored

negative.fixture: stale page token, changed filter, changed count, vanished ids and oversize plans refused with no effect; unknown outcome never repeated; partial runs are unknown with a per-record report

security_and_source_permissions: Only outcomes the source proved changed nothing are repeated; plans are bounded; no write is retried after a possible commit.
performance_memory_storage: Items run sequentially; large runs are bounded by plan limits and the per-source limiter.
known_limitations: Plans are re-resolved through a Lister the caller supplies; a source-specific listing adapter is the caller's
Concurrent mutation is detected by re-resolution before each run, not by locks
